text:
Sam Rivera: Hi all — small calendar snag: Day 2 orientation shows at 09:00 for me but 00:00 as an "all day" event on my mobile calendar. Anyone else seeing midnight placeholders?
Nina Park: Hey @Sam — yes, that happens when our ICS export includes a floating timezone plus a UTC-anchored reminder. Mobile clients sometimes render the floating one as all-day.
Sam Rivera: Ugh. Is there a safe way to remove the midnight one without declining the real invite?
Nina Park: For iOS: open the all-day event > Edit > toggle off "All-day" if editable, otherwise decline the all-day entry and don't send response. On Android/Outlook mobile it's usually accept+delete the duplicate.
Sam Rivera: Cool, thanks. Also, the invite says "recording + captions" — will captions be attached to the recording or a separate transcript?
Onboard Bot: @channel Captions: we run auto-captioning after cloud processing. Captions are embedded in the MP4 and we also produce a VTT transcript linked alongside the presigned S3 URL. VTT posted in this thread when available.
Sam Rivera: Helpful. If my calendar client blocks the presigned link redirect, is there a fallback? My phone blocks redirects to external sites.
IT Support: If redirects are blocked, DM us and we can post a short direct URL (no redirect) or email you the GDrive link once the archive copy is ready.
Nina Park: Note: presigned links expire in 7 days. For longer access we copy recordings+VTT to the onboarding Drive and to the team Notion page within 48h.
Sam Rivera: One more: recurring calendar entry — will Day 1/Day 2 be separate events or a repeating multi-day series? I worry accepting a series might block unrelated meetings.
Calendar Team: We intentionally send separate events for Day 1/Day 2/Wrap to avoid long recurring blocks. If you received a single recurring event that was an error from the export; decline and re-add the correct separate events (look for suffix "(local)"). We'll push a fix to the exporter tonight.
Sam Rivera: Appreciate it. Could the ICS include a short note about where captions/transcripts land? Saves us posting here later.
Nina Park: Good idea — adding to the onboarding task list. For now, search this channel for "Onboard Bot" after sessions for the quicklink.
Onboard Bot: Calendar exporter update scheduled: 03/26 01:00 UTC -> fix duplicate/floating ICS. Will notify @new-hires on completion.
Sam Rivera: Great, thanks everyone!
